name: Giovanni Colosimo
bioAdditions: Giovanni was baptized Domenico Giovanni on 5 August 1759, son of Francesco Colosimo (son of the late Antonio) and Giulia Putaro (S1). He married Teresa Cicco on 10 November 1777 (S2). He died on 11 February 1833 and was buried the next day as Teresa's widower (S3, S4). The civil death act names his mother as Francesca Manfredi, but his marriage and baptism both say Giulia Putaro.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism, marriage, death and burial all indexed; son Luigi's records name him.
